I now also have 2 C64 Maxis, the Atari The 400, and a The Spectrum for Christmas. I don't rush out and buy every damn thing they release. I don't have space for all of that. And I don't have massive nostalgia for all systems. But I really do love what they do! Even if they are not perfect. #retrogaming

https://mastodon.social/@zeratul2099@mas.name: zeratul2099
https://mastodon.social/@zeratul2099@mas.text: Watched the Street Fighter movie from 1994 yesterday. Not as bad as I suspected. Don't get me wrong, it is no good movie, it is involuntarily comical and it has, except for the characters, nothing to do with the games. But Raul Julia as M Bison carries the whole movie. A great piece of acting of the movies villain. It is pure fun to watch his monologues. Sadly, Raul Julia passed away after the filming and just before the release of the movie. #retrogaming #streetfighter #gamingmovies #sf2

https://mastodon.social/@openrisk/117660.text: Ok gaming has not been my thing for... some time 😅 but really surprised these ultra-mega-productions like #GTA6 are actually just... single player games? There is probably good reasons for it in terms of gameplay but given the collective mania one would think that a massively multi-player universe on the same themes would be popular? Maybe an opportunity for the #fediverse , to revive the #MUD and #MMORPG and whatnot era but with the immensely better hardware and software of today?
